newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea probes cafe fire, 11 now reported dead.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea probes cafe fire, 11 now reported dead.

text.p: South Korean investigators on Monday sifted through a burned out cafe for clues to a fire that killed 11 young revellers and critically injured three others.
Five of the victims were women.

Firefighters initially put the death toll from Sunday's blaze at the cramped, underground, Rollings Stones cafe in a fashionable bar district of the capital at 12, and said a gas explosion was to blame.
On Monday, however, fire officials ruled out gas as the cause of the fire, which occured on the last day of the four-day Korean Thanksgiving holiday.
